* [[Captain Nealith's Brother]]

|bookcontents = 

Dear, brother, I fear that my soul has been overtaken by a great evil. My sanity barely hangs on by a thread.

My dreams of the sweet red blood of others are soon to drive me mad.  The howls in the night call to me.

It is best for me to leave.  I pray that I can deliver this note before I go mad.

Please understand that it is better that I am never seen again.

Goodbye.  Keep up the fight for the forest folk.
